judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Footer image of the sponsors/partners strip ('Temporada 2026': Lei Rouanet, Petrobras, Motiva, Instituto Votorantim, Vale, IDBrasil, Museu da Língua Portuguesa, Fundação Roberto Marinho, Cult SP, Governo de SP, Ministério da Cultura, Governo do Brasil). alt='Barra de parceiros' (partners bar) does describe what the image is, so the claim that it describes something the image does not show is wrong. The image does fail 1.1.1 for a different reason: the alt is insufficient, since it omits the sponsor names and roles the logos convey and no nearby text lists them (checked in the snapshot and the live HTML).

judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: Icon-only social link (YouTube) in the footer: a white Font Awesome glyph on a filled #a4a4a4 grey square (sampled from the screenshot: 164,164,164 and white), 2.49:1, under 3:1. The glyph is the only visual identifier of the link (name is sr-only text), so 1.4.11 applies. The logo/essential exception does not hold: the white-on-grey treatment is an author styling choice, not the brands' mandated colours, which the Understanding document says is not exempt. The live page still has the same markup.
